name: cubica-monorepo
description: Workspace root for Cubica SDK packages, games and supporting apps.

scripts.build:web:sequential: npm run build --workspace @cubica/player-web && npm run build --workspace @cubica/editor-web
scripts.verify:runtime-api: npm run typecheck --workspace services/runtime-api && npm test --workspace services/runtime-api && npm run smoke --workspace services/runtime-api
scripts.verify:player-web: npm run typecheck --workspace @cubica/player-web && npm test --workspace @cubica/player-web && npm run build --workspace @cubica/player-web
scripts.verify:contracts-knowledge: npm run generate:types:check --workspace @cubica/product-context && npm run typecheck --workspace @cubica/product-context && npm run test --workspace @cubica/product-context -- --run contracts policy
scripts.verify:product-context: node -e "if (!process.env.TEST_PRODUCT_CONTEXT_DATABASE_URL) { console.error('TEST_PRODUCT_CONTEXT_DATABASE_URL is required for the Stage 1 acceptance suite.'); process.exit(1) }" && npm run generate:types:check --workspace @cubica/product-context && npm run typecheck --workspace @cubica/product-context && npm run test:acceptance --workspace @cubica/product-context
scripts.verify:product-context-shadow-activation: node -e "if (!process.env.TEST_PRODUCT_CONTEXT_DATABASE_URL) { console.error('TEST_PRODUCT_CONTEXT_DATABASE_URL is required for the shadow activation rehearsal.'); process.exit(1) }" && npm run test --workspace @cubica/product-context -- --run shadow-activation-harness && node --test services/portal-backend/test/product-context-shadow-authorization.test.js && npm test --workspace @cubica/editor-web -- --run src/lib/product-context-shadow.test.ts app/api/editor/agent/ag-ui/route.test.ts app/api/copilotkit/route.test.ts && npm run verify:product-context-isolation
scripts.verify:editor-web: npm run typecheck --workspace @cubica/editor-web && npm run build --workspace @cubica/editor-web
scripts.verify:canonical: npm run verify:node-runtime && npm run verify:legacy && npm run verify:codex-agent-routing && npm run verify:external-skills && npm run verify:manifest-authoring && npm run verify:contracts-schema-parity && npm run verify:contracts-manifest && npm run verify:contracts-runtime && npm run verify:contracts-session && npm run verify:game-agnostic && npm run verify:player-core-seam && npm run verify:metric-jsonlogic-subset && npm run verify:game-assets && npm run verify:game-stylesheets && npm run verify:api-contracts && npm run verify:contracts-ai && npm run verify:agent-ui-boundaries && npm run verify:runtime-api && npm run verify:player-web && npm test --workspace @cubica/view-protocol && npm run verify:editor-engine && npm run verify:editor-web && npm run verify:cards-money-trains-mock
scripts.verify:canonical:ci: npm run verify:node-runtime && npm run verify:agent-instructions && npm run verify:codex-agent-routing && npm run verify:external-skills && npm run verify:contracts-schema-parity && npm run verify:contracts-manifest && npm run verify:contracts-runtime && npm run verify:contracts-session && npm run verify:game-agnostic && npm run verify:player-core-seam && npm run verify:metric-jsonlogic-subset && npm run verify:game-assets && npm run verify:game-stylesheets && npm run verify:api-contracts && npm run verify:contracts-ai && npm run verify:agent-ui-boundaries && npm run verify:runtime-api && npm run verify:player-web:ci && npm test --workspace @cubica/view-protocol && npm run verify:editor-engine && npm run verify:editor-web && npm run verify:cards-money-trains-mock
